correctness.rationale: The universal homogeneous strict poset has the extension property and quantifier elimination: each nonalgebraic one-point type over a weak order is a compatible lower ideal L and disjoint upper filter U, with all L below all U. Each nonempty L has one highest occupied antichain and 2^n_i-1 subset options, similarly for U; both boundaries occupy strictly separated levels. This proves T(P)=1+2Σa_i+Σ_{i<j}a_i a_j. The product of within-level symmetric groups acts transitively on subsets of each fixed size, replacing a_i by n_i and giving O(P). Species for ordered nonempty labelled blocks yield W=(2−exp z)^−1, F_T=W+2AW²+A²W³ with A=exp(2z)−exp z, and F_O=W+2CW²+C²W³ with C=z exp z. The unique nearest pole ρ=log 2 has cubic terms 1/[2(ρ−z)^3] and ρ²/[2(ρ−z)^3], leading to n²/(2ρ²)+O(n), n²/2+O(n) and the ratio of expectations ρ^−2. Independently reconstructed direct ternary one-point consistency/orbit counts for all 63 block compositions of n≤6; finite tests do not prove singularity asymptotics.
